## Integrated-M1 criteria

Assess the full original M1-01 playable exit and delivery gate, with the later approved gameplay improvements:

1. **Connected expedition and mystery:** actual in-engine opening/skip/pause → usable pod facilities → reef/island investigation in either order → habitat-linked gathering/crafting → Dart/Canopy C04 → useful cargo/optional trim return → persistent second session. Regional clues/notebook/observations retain canon, ambiguity, provenance and optional-note independence. Future Basin content is honestly labelled unfinished.
2. **Resources, capability and preparation:** single runtime registry/source habitats; guaranteed real bundles/stock/capacity and recipe graph; at least25% first conservative return oxygen/power; personal150m versus Dart180m constraints and clear egress. Shared local ingredients/bulk storage, one-cell paid pulse, separate cell recharge/hull service, optional trim tradeoff and recoverable instance ownership work together without duplication, remote spending or silent rebilling of old saves.
3. **Survival, ecology and real loss:** food without thirst, accessible hand food/empty-food recovery, reliable refuges and pause. Observable ecological/source relations, readable warning/evasion/deterrence and free retreat. Healthy battery depletion is distinct from disabled hull. Actual player incapacity/cache recovery and repeated failure retain knowledge/tools/cargo recovery; current installed-trim recovery preserves modules and bound maintenance provenance. Do not call the new C hull-disable branch a player-incapacity test; assess the retained ordinary repeated-failure evidence and subsequent corrections separately.
4. **Physics and carrier feasibility before expansion:** diver/scout/representative hull sweeps and waterline/shore/ramp transitions, deliberate boarding/exit/clearance, old earned placement, strict bounds. Simplified production-state carrier fixture proves station keeping, walkable interior, compact/medium configurations, dry Spindle while another launches, blocked exits/atomic detachment, transition interruption/reload and supported M1 refuge fallback. It does not prove earned campaign carrier or registered-mobile-refuge behavior, which remain explicit M2 obligations.
5. **Presentation and runtime composition:** original richer-cel assets support interaction scale/navigation; glass/apertures, optics and cockpit follow authority; usable menus/keyboard focus/warnings/visual audio equivalents, save/unsaved Export and graphics recovery remain coherent. Inspect actual route and appearance evidence. Audio is locally bundled; muted evidence cannot prove audible mix. Identify concrete blockers separately from later polish or human-test hypotheses.
6. **Persistent, reviewable integrated state:** versioned strict saves/migration, all commands/refusals atomic, inventory/fleet/berth/operation IDs coherent, knowledge/depletion/installed items retained, safe legacy placement and exact journal preservation. Current checks and actual New/Continue/reload/pauses support composition. No acceptance if a remaining blocker, unsupported required M1 behavior or scope violation is found.

M1 is the first linked expedition, not the ten-hour campaign. Seven regions, six campaign hulls, mobile-home registration, deep rescue topology, both ending strategies and the authored ending remain M2–M4. Human learning/enjoyment/duration, representative dedicated-GPU performance and audible-mix limits remain explicit; neither model pair waives them. Do not inflate M1 into full-campaign acceptance or require every later system to exist in M1.
